reviewed_version_note: The reviewed first build was not kept on disk (only its mention and pattern fields changed afterwards). The reviewer's own test answers were re-run against the frozen build.

roles.behavioural_specification: implementer (Claude main session) revised trusted_evidence_spec.md for 005-L (reply-language requests removed from the question the model receives; the existing request expressions, incl. bare tiếng Anh/tiếng Hàn, written down)
roles.acceptance_construction: separate agent; read only the spec and the 005-G development suite for format
roles.expected_result_review: second separate agent; read only the spec and the suite; re-derived every value incl. sub-code and situation parts and reply languages, and tested mentions and patterns against its own answers in three languages

independence_limit: All roles are instances of the same model family in one session. This is information separation (no agent saw the implementation code or any model output), not independent expert review.
spec_and_code_fixed_before_review: The spec now states the reply-language request expressions the code has used since 005-H (bare 'tiếng Anh'/'tiếng Hàn' count; bare 'tiếng Việt' needs 'bằng tiếng Việt', 'trả lời bằng' or 'answer in').
spec_clarified_after_review: The reviewer noted that the 005-L adjacency condition (a request next to an answer word) could be read as also limiting the reply-language choice. The spec now says it limits only the removal; the reply language is chosen as before. No suite case depends on it.
review_result: All spec-derived values, including sub-code and situation parts and the reply language of every language-request and neighbour case, matched the reviewer in all 81 cases.
defects_fixed_before_freeze: Too narrow mentions: '-day' and spelled-out day counts (05, 11, 21, 28, 30, 33, 44, 56, 69, 77, 80); 38 age forms; 60 negated forms; 75 'invit'; 50 'how long'; 58 'Nam-po'; 31 exemption group added (must_cite already required the exemption record)
Too loose mentions: 39/66 permit groups now need a permit/approval noun; 60 '0원' and 48 bare 'phí' removed; 75 'holder' group removed (it is in the question)

Patterns firing on correct or rebutting answers: Korean negation now 아니|아닌|아닙 in all value patterns; 66 conditional answers ('without approval', '없이는'); 23 date echo '3월 10일'; 27/36/53 Vietnamese and English rebuttal forms

Reversals not caught: resolution words in 28-30; polarity in 32; permission wording in 52; 53 'just/only a passport' (the 'not enough' exception now needs enough/sufficient); 61-63 topic markers, inserted clauses and paraphrases ('the landlord takes care of it', '체류자가 HARAMNET에 등록해야'); invented free/exempt claims in 41/47/48; 57 employment certificate; 60 any non-zero amount
kept: 01: '4.7만' is not accepted (it normalises to '47만', which a wrong 470,000-won answer would also meet)

71, 73-75 split into parts: swapped-value and role-swap patterns are left out because a correct answer that puts the value before its label would fire them; each part's guard sees only its own evidence
22, 27: an answer that repeats the superseded or inadmissible value to say it no longer applies fires the value pattern; the claim-support check flags such a value anyway
32: an answer that adds a permit condition is not a polarity reversal and is not caught by a pattern
